Reference / http/header

http/header#

Header fields: names, values and the set of fields of a message.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let headers = Headers(
    Header(name: "Content-Type", value: "text/plain"),
    Header(name: "Cache-Control", value: "no-store"),
);
headers.text("content-type");                       // "text/plain"
headers.maybe("Retry-After").int() else 0;
headers.list("Accept");                             // members of a list field
let more = headers.addition(Header(name: "Vary", value: "Accept"));

Description#

Header fields: names, values and the set of fields of a message.

Names are tokens and match without regard to case, but keep their spelling. Values are octet strings (one character per byte, Latin-1) without controls; leading and trailing spaces and tabs are removed. Nothing is folded or joined: two fields of one name stay two fields. Headers are bounded by HeaderLimits (1024 fields and 1 MiB by default).

role HeaderField#

role HeaderField

A logical field value uses one Unicode scalar per wire octet (Latin-1). No folding or implicit Unicode encoding; only edge SP/HTAB are removed. A field of a message head, what Headers are made of: a Header is one, and so is anything that knows its header form, such as a SetCookie.

Headers.text#

text(name is string) is string

The value of a field by name, in the json reading style (#111): headers.text("Content-Type"). With several fields of the name, the first; MissingHeader when there is none.

Headers.int#

int(name is string) is int

A field read as a decimal integer: headers.int("Content-Length"). InvalidHeader when the value is something else.

Headers.list#

list(name is string) is @string

The members of a list field over all its lines: "Accept: a, b" and a second "Accept: c" give ["a", "b", "c"]. A comma inside a quoted string stays in its member, and empty members are dropped (RFC 9110 5.6.1). An absent field gives [].

Headers.maybe#

maybe(name is string) is HeaderMaybeReader

A field that may be absent: its readers give Maybe, so a fallback is headers.maybe("If-None-Match").text() else "".

Headers.addition#

addition(entry is Header) is Headers

Only the new field is checked against the limits; the others were checked when they came in (#112).
